title: Rakazo
lede: Rakazo is an open-source, self-hostable platform for persistent AI bots that keep working after the chat closes, each with its own memory, schedule and computer.

points: Every bot gets its own machine, including a browser you can watch live and take control of.
Memory carries across tasks, and routines can fire on a schedule, an incoming email or a webhook.
Works with any model or sandbox provider; the team says ChatGPT and Claude subscriptions are supported.
Connects to Gmail, Slack, GitHub, Notion, Linear and any MCP server, and supports group chats.
Clients ship for web, desktop, iPhone and Android.

sections.text: Developers and teams who want always-on agent assistants but prefer to keep the model choice, API keys and data on their own machines.
Self-hosting is free; the launch comment says the hosted cloud version costs $15 a month.
